Product:{\"sku\":\"7100118533\"}.name: Starsand Island
Product:{\"sku\":\"7100118533\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Escape the Urban Grind and Find Your Island Paradise

Welcome to Starsand Island, a peaceful coastal retreat known as the "Star of the Deep Sea." Leave the pressures of city life behind and embrace a slower pace surrounded by sunshine, ocean breezes, and breathtaking natural scenery.

Build the island life you've always dreamed of. Farm, fish, raise adorable animals, and explore a vibrant world filled with hidden secrets. Whether you're relaxing with capybaras, cats, and dogs, wandering through the enchanting Moonlit Forest, or watching the sunset by the sea, every day offers a new way to unwind.

Build Your Dream Island Home

Grow tropical crops, care for livestock, and create a beautiful countryside home that reflects your style. Design gardens, decorate your villa, and shape the island with extensive customization options.

Explore Together

Play solo or team up with up to 4 players online. Invite friends to visit your island, farm together, go fishing, gather resources, build your dream community, or set off on adventures as a team. Whether you're creating the perfect island getaway or exploring the world together, every moment is more fun with friends.

Travel Without Limits

Cruise along scenic coastal roads on a longboard, ride through lush forests on a retro scooter, or set sail to discover neighboring islands. Travel at your own pace and uncover new places, resources, and surprises waiting beyond the horizon.

Make Meaningful Connections

Meet a cast of warm-hearted islanders, each with their own personality and story. Build friendships through everyday life, complete quests together, and deepen relationships. You may even find romance and start a new chapter with someone special.

Adventure Beyond the Peaceful Shore

The island holds more than peaceful scenery. Explore mysterious ruins, venture into ancient caverns, gather rare resources, and battle strange creatures using a variety of weapons and combat skills. Every expedition brings new discoveries, valuable treasures, and exciting challenges.
